text:
Tara (AE): Heads-up  enterprise POC with Northbridge starts in two weeks. Procurement sent a SIG/CAIQ and is pressing for: explicit IR timeline, firm breach-notification SLA, and whether Redwood will hold keys during a 6-week POC. They want a buyer-facing packet by tomorrow 9am PT.

Gus (Security): I can take SIG/CAIQ + IR excerpt. Short answer on keys: default is BYOK for VPC. Temporary escrow can be offered as a paid, auditable option but requires Legal & Risk approval and PS involvement.

Tara (AE): They asked for this exact line in the packet: "If Redwood detects a security incident affecting Northbridge customer data, when will we be notified?" Put that verbatim.

Ellen (Legal): Key escrow is allowed only with strict contractual guardrails. We'll require: narrow purpose clause, deletion certificate, elevated indemnity or fee, and explicit forensic cooperation terms. I prefer framing escrow as a paid add-on with a deletion certificate delivered within 5 business days of POC termination.

Pri (Solutions): From infra: 6-week POC, VPC, demo dataset only, 4 GPU nodes. Pricing suggestion: 60% off first 6 weeks for strategic pilots + two enablement sessions. Escrow add-on: one-time vaulting fee + PS days to import/export keys and verify deletion.

Gus (Security): IR timeline (concise, for procurement):

```
IR summary:
- Alert acknowledgement: within 1 hour
- Initial triage & scope: 0-24 hours
- Containment actions: ongoing, target within 24-48 hours
- Customer notification: within 72 hours of confirmed customer-impacting incident (operational baseline)
- Enterprise SLA option: 48 hours notification subject to negotiated liability cap and active cooperation on forensics
- Detailed post-incident report: within 10 business days
Contacts: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai, comms@redwood.ai
```

Tara (AE): Northbridge procurement is pushing for 48h flat. Can we list the two options and explain what extra they'd need to accept?

Ellen (Legal): Yes. We'll include two clause snippets: (A) Standard: 72h; (B) Enterprise: 48h but requires increased liability cap or specific cyber insurance, plus cooperation in preserving evidence and granting limited forensic access. I'll add a short paragraph about what "active cooperation" means.

Pri (Solutions): Also include SOC2 (redacted) link and last pentest date. Northbridge wants evidence.

Gus (Security): SOC2 (redacted): https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Latest pentest: 2026-08-12. I'll attach the SIG/CAIQ answers and call out controls that are Private-only with compensating controls (audit logs, RBAC, PS access limitations).

Tara (AE): They also want proof-of-deletion specifics: Ellen suggested 5 business days. Can we commit to that?

Ellen (Legal): We can commit to delivering a signed deletion certificate within 5 business days post-POC for escrowed keys, plus logs showing the key removal operation and HSM audit trail export. That will be in the escrow addendum.

Gus (Security): We'll also offer an optional joint forensics window (48 hours) for incidents occurring during the POC; requires NDA and PS support. Include that as a value-added item for enterprise customers.

Pri (Solutions): SOW notes: no production data in POC unless explicitly approved and documented; demo dataset only. Add PS hours for onboarding and key lifecycle tasks if escrow requested.

asset-bot: asset-bot: Uploaded files: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/northbridge-sig-caiq-1783205555.pdf, https://files.redwood/sales/poc/northbridge-poc-sow-1783205555.pdf

Tara (AE): Perfect. Gus- please drop SIG/CAIQ answers and IR excerpt; Ellen please add the two clause snippets + escrow addendum bullets; Pri finalize SOW/pricing. I'll assemble and send by 08:30 PT tomorrow.

Gus (Security): Done: uploaded SIG answers and IR playbook excerpt. Added contact matrix and recommended notification flow.

Ellen (Legal): Dropped clause snippets and escrow addendum draft in the contracts folder. Will add a short note about insurance requirement for 48h SLA option.

Pri (Solutions): SOW uploaded with 6-week pricing and escrow pricing options. Note: escrow requires PS verification and HSM-backed vaulting.

Tara (AE): Thanks all. Final note for packet language: be explicit about which controls are only available in Private deployments and list compensating measures for VPC. Procurement expects clarity.

Gus (Security): Will add a short table in the SIG answers (Private-only vs available) and list compensating controls.

Tara (AE): Closing loop. If Northbridge insists on 48h without insurance or indemnity, we'll decline and offer standard 72h + the enterprise option as negotiable. Sending tomorrow AM. Thanks :thumbsup:
